backup.production_rule: Function bodies and one new read function only; no table, column or row is touched. (1) admin_stays_v1 keeps its signature, return columns, language, SECURITY DEFINER, search_path and grants (authenticated only) and its SQL body byte-for-byte (live md5 e2f41dcc6de28ba1ebe23b4534b6443d, CR stripped, read 2026-10-14); it is wrapped behind a one-row gate, new function admin_stays_gate_v1 (no API role can execute it), which raises 42501 not_authorized unless the session is owner/admin (manage_operations) or finance (read_finance, aal2), or has no JWT. Visible change: a cleaner, inspector or maintenance session is refused by admin_stays_v1 AND by the functions that read it (get_hospitality_metrics_v1, get_admin_overview_v1, get_guest_timeline_v1, run_health_checks_v1, get_report_drilldown_v1); none of the staff-app cleaner screens call them (only the Manage module, owner/admin). The Edge Functions do not call admin_stays_v1 (cascade-core/tools.ts reads the booking tables with the service key; service_role has never had EXECUTE). (2) New staff_calendar_history_v1(date, date, uuid default the property): owner/admin only, 400-day cap, source/id/dates/nights/status/first name only. The migration stops itself unless the live admin_stays_v1 still hashes to the md5 above. (3) staff_pay_admin_step_v1 (live md5 ee76bfac5542808058969b731940f343) gains one guard: 'cancel' on a paying request whose payer is not the caller returns not_yours (was: cancelled it). Same signature, return type, security mode and grants; a row Telegram started (no app payer) is also not_yours from the app. The migration also stops unless this body still hashes to that md5.

forward_verification.name: gate_exists_and_no_api_role_can_execute_it
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 1 and not bool_or(has_function_privilege('authenticated', p.oid, 'execute') or has_function_privilege('anon', p.oid, 'execute') or has_function_privilege('service_role', p.oid, 'execute')) from pg_proc p where p.oid = 'public.admin_stays_gate_v1(uuid)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: admin_stays_v1_calls_the_gate_and_is_still_a_definer_with_an_empty_search_path
forward_verification.query: select prosrc ~ 'admin_stays_gate_v1' and prosecdef and proconfig @> array['search_path=""'] from pg_proc where oid = 'public.admin_stays_v1(uuid)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: admin_stays_v1_grants_are_unchanged_authenticated_only
forward_verification.query: select has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.admin_stays_v1(uuid)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.admin_stays_v1(uuid)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.admin_stays_v1(uuid)', 'execute')

forward_verification.name: admin_stays_v1_return_columns_are_unchanged
forward_verification.query: select pg_get_function_result('public.admin_stays_v1(uuid)'::regprocedure) = 'TABLE(stay_kind text, stay_id uuid, code text, guest_id uuid, guest_name text, checkin date, checkout date, nights integer, status text, accommodation_total numeric, allocation_method text, booking_created date, payout_date date, host_payout numeric)'

forward_verification.name: history_rpc_exists_authenticated_only_and_names_no_money_or_contact_column
forward_verification.query: select has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.staff_calendar_history_v1(date, date, uuid)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.staff_calendar_history_v1(date, date, uuid)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.staff_calendar_history_v1(date, date, uuid)', 'execute') and (select prosrc !~* '(payout|accommodation_total|guest_email|guest_phone|psid|payout_qrph)' from pg_proc where oid = 'public.staff_calendar_history_v1(date, date, uuid)'::regprocedure)

forward_verification.name: pay_step_has_the_cancel_ownership_guard_and_keeps_its_grants
forward_verification.query: select (select prosrc ~ 'p_step = ''cancel'' and v_r.status = ''paying'' and v_r.paying_by_user_id is distinct from v_uid' and prosecdef from pg_proc where oid = 'public.staff_pay_admin_step_v1(uuid,text)'::regprocedure) and has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.staff_pay_admin_step_v1(uuid,text)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.staff_pay_admin_step_v1(uuid,text)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.staff_pay_admin_step_v1(uuid,text)', 'execute')

rollback.safe_until: any time. Nothing is written; rolling back only restores the admin_stays_v1 body (the privacy hole returns) and drops the two new functions.
